mapper.select: SELECT account_id, username, display_name, password_hash, created_at FROM user_account WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT account_id, username, display_name, password_hash, created_at FROM user_account WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_account (account_id, username, display_name, password_hash, created_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{username}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_id = account_id
